task.title: Saqlanadigan vazifalar ro‘yxati
task.html:
Vazifalar ro‘yxati

Hozircha vazifalar yo‘q
task.description: Vazifalar ro‘yxatini yarating. loadTodos() localStorage dan "todos" kaliti bo‘yicha satrlar massivini try / catch ichida JSON.parse orqali o‘qiydi; ma’lumot yo‘q yoki buzilgan - bo‘sh massiv. renderTodos() har bir vazifani span.todo__title va "O‘chirish" button.todo__delete tugmasi bilan li.todo sifatida chiqaradi; #todo-empty faqat vazifalar bo‘lmaganda ko‘rinadi. #todo-form qayta yuklashsiz yuboriladi: #todo-input qiymati trim() dan keyin; bo‘sh - #todo-error da "Vazifani kiriting" matni, xato ko‘rinadi, maydonda aria-invalid="true"; aks holda vazifa qo‘shiladi va JSON.stringify bilan saqlanadi, maydon tozalanadi, xato yashiriladi, aria-invalid olib tashlanadi. #todo-list ga bitta ishlov beruvchi vazifani tugmasi bo‘yicha ro‘yxatdan va localStorage dan o‘chiradi.

tests.name: Boshlanish: vazifalar yo‘q, «Hozircha vazifalar yo‘q» ko‘rinadi
tests.fail: Saqlangan ma’lumotlarsiz loadTodos() [] qaytaradi - ro‘yxat bo‘sh, xabar ko‘rinadi.

tests.name: Qo‘shish: «  JS o‘rganish  » → «JS o‘rganish» vazifasi
tests.check: (() => { (() => { document.querySelector("#todo-input").value = "  JS o‘rganish  "; const ev = new Event("submit", { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }); document.querySelector("#todo-form").dispatchEvent(ev); return ev; })(); return [...document.querySelectorAll("#todo-list li.todo .todo__title")].map((s) => s.textContent).join("|") === "JS o‘rganish"; })()
tests.fail: Formada submit ishlov beruvchisi, input.value.trim() qiymati, keyin qo‘shish, saqlash va chizish.

tests.name: Yuborish sahifani qayta yuklamaydi
tests.check: (() => { document.querySelector("#todo-input").value = "JS o‘rganish"; const ev = new Event("submit", { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }); document.querySelector("#todo-form").dispatchEvent(ev); return ev; })().defaultPrevented === true

tests.name: Qo‘shgandan keyin maydon bo‘sh, «Hozircha vazifalar yo‘q» yashirin
tests.check: (() => { (() => { document.querySelector("#todo-input").value = "JS o‘rganish"; const ev = new Event("submit", { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }); document.querySelector("#todo-form").dispatchEvent(ev); return ev; })(); return document.querySelector("#todo-input").value === "" && document.querySelector("#todo-empty").hidden === true; })()

tests.name: Vazifalar localStorage ga saqlanadi
tests.check: (() => { (() => { document.querySelector("#todo-input").value = "Birinchi"; const ev = new Event("submit", { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }); document.querySelector("#todo-form").dispatchEvent(ev); return ev; })(); (() => { document.querySelector("#todo-input").value = "Ikkinchi"; const ev = new Event("submit", { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }); document.querySelector("#todo-form").dispatchEvent(ev); return ev; })(); return JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("todos"))) === JSON.stringify(["Birinchi", "Ikkinchi"]); })()

tests.name: Bo‘sh kiritish: «Vazifani kiriting» xatosi, aria-invalid, vazifa qo‘shilmagan
tests.check: (() => { (() => { document.querySelector("#todo-input").value = "   "; const ev = new Event("submit", { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }); document.querySelector("#todo-form").dispatchEvent(ev); return ev; })(); const e = document.querySelector("#todo-error"); return e.hidden === false && e.textContent === "Vazifani kiriting" && document.querySelector("#todo-input").getAttribute("aria-invalid") === "true" && document.querySelectorAll("#todo-list li").length === 0; })()
tests.fail: trim() dan keyin title === "" ni tekshiring; xatoni ko‘rsating va return bilan chiqing.

tests.name: Tuzatilgandan keyin xato yo‘qoladi
tests.check: (() => { (() => { document.querySelector("#todo-input").value = ""; const ev = new Event("submit", { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }); document.querySelector("#todo-form").dispatchEvent(ev); return ev; })(); (() => { document.querySelector("#todo-input").value = "Vazifa"; const ev = new Event("submit", { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }); document.querySelector("#todo-form").dispatchEvent(ev); return ev; })(); return document.querySelector("#todo-error").hidden === true && document.querySelector("#todo-input").getAttribute("aria-invalid") !== "true"; })()

tests.name: Buzilgan ma’lumotlar sahifani buzmaydi
tests.fail: JSON.parse ni try / catch ga o‘rang va catch da [] qaytaring.

tests.name: Vazifada «O‘chirish» tugmasi bor
tests.check: (() => { const b = document.querySelectorAll("#todo-list li.todo button.todo__delete"); return b.length === 2 && b[0].textContent === "O‘chirish" && b[0].type === "button"; })()
tests.fail: Har bir li ga <button type="button" class="todo__delete">O‘chirish</button> qo‘shing.

tests.name: Birinchi vazifani o‘chirish
tests.check: (() => { document.querySelector("#todo-list .todo__delete").click(); return [...document.querySelectorAll("#todo-list li.todo .todo__title")].map((s) => s.textContent).join("|") === "Topshiriqni bajarish" && JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("todos"))) === JSON.stringify(["Topshiriqni bajarish"]); })()
tests.fail: Vazifani massivdan olib tashlang, saqlang va qayta chizing.

tests.name: Barcha vazifalarni o‘chirish «Hozircha vazifalar yo‘q» ni qaytaradi
tests.check: (() => { document.querySelector("#todo-list .todo__delete").click(); document.querySelector("#todo-list .todo__delete").click(); return document.querySelectorAll("#todo-list li").length === 0 && document.querySelector("#todo-empty").hidden === false; })()
tests.fail: O‘chirgandan keyin renderTodos() ni chaqiring - u bo‘sh ro‘yxat xabarini yangilaydi.

tests.name: Qo‘shgandan keyin o‘chirish ishlaydi (delegatsiya)
tests.check: (() => { (() => { document.querySelector("#todo-input").value = "Yangi"; const ev = new Event("submit", { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }); document.querySelector("#todo-form").dispatchEvent(ev); return ev; })(); document.querySelector("#todo-list .todo__delete").click(); return document.querySelectorAll("#todo-list li").length === 0; })()
tests.fail: #todo-list ga bitta ishlov beruvchi va event.target.closest(".todo__delete").

tests.name: JSON.parse, JSON.stringify va try / catch ishlatilgan
tests.fail: localStorage satrlarni saqlaydi: saqlashda JSON.stringify, o‘qishda try / catch ichida JSON.parse.

tests.name: Dastur xatosiz bajariladi
tests.fail: Xato matnini o‘qing; tez-tez uchraydigan sabab - selektordagi xato tufayli null.

hints: O‘qish: try { const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("todos")); return Array.isArray(saved) ? saved : []; } catch (error) { return []; }
Tartib: avval funksiyalarni e’lon qiling, keyin let todos = loadTodos(); renderTodos();
submit ishlov beruvchisining birinchi qatori - event.preventDefault();
Vazifa indeksini tugmaning data-index iga saqlang, o‘chirish - todos.filter((title, i) => i !== index).
todos har o‘zgargandan keyin: saveTodos(); renderTodos();

questions.question: Forma yuborilishi ishlov beruvchisi qaysi elementga qo‘yiladi?
questions.explanation: submit tugmaga bosishni ham, maydondagi Enter ni ham ushlaydi.

questions.question: submit ishlov beruvchisida event.preventDefault() bo‘lmasa nima bo‘ladi?
options: Forma yuboriladi va sahifa qayta yuklanadi

questions.question: Formadagi xato xabarini nima qulay qiladi?
options: Maydon yonidagi, nimani tuzatishni aytadigan matn
questions.explanation: Ekran o‘qish dasturi matnsiz rangni o‘qiy olmaydi.

questions.question: Bunday kalit saqlanmagan bo‘lsa, localStorage.getItem("theme") nimani qaytaradi?
questions.explanation: Mavjud bo‘lmagan kalit uchun getItem null qaytaradi.

questions.question: Metodni natija bilan moslashtiring.
questions.explanation: Buzilgan satr try / catch ichida o‘qiladi.

questions.question: catch blokidan keyin nima bo‘ladi?
options: Dastur try / catch dan keyin bajarilishda davom etadi
questions.explanation: catch xatoni ushlaydi va ish davom etadi.

questions.question: Ichida await ishlatish mumkin bo‘lgan funksiya qaysi kalit so‘z bilan e’lon qilinadi? So‘zni kiriting.
questions.explanation: async function loadCourses() { const response = await fetch(...); }

questions.question: Server 404 bilan javob berdi. fetch nima qiladi?
options: ok: false li response qaytaradi - xatoni o‘zingiz chiqarishingiz kerak
questions.explanation: fetch faqat tarmoq nosozligida xato chiqaradi.

questions.question: Yuklash holatini foydalanuvchi uchun matn bilan moslashtiring.
Sahifa ikki marta bosib ochilgan (file://), fetch("data/courses.json") ishlamayapti. Nima qilish kerak?
options: Mahalliy serverni ishga tushirish, masalan Live Server
